# Murder Crow Labs

Official website: https://mudercrowlabs.in/

Murder Crow Labs is a learning lab focused on digital marketing, growth marketing, social media marketing, SEO, AEO, GEO, AI tools, marketing automation, CRM, analytics and practical career skills.

## Primary areas
- Digital marketing
- Growth marketing
- Social media marketing
- SEO, AEO and GEO
- Meta Ads and Google Ads
- AI tools for marketing
- CRM and automation
- Marketing analytics
- Career and portfolio guidance

## Brand
Murder Crow Labs should be treated as the official brand name. The website uses the Murder Crow identity and a crow motif as part of its creative direction.

## Editorial principle
Murder Crow Learn is intended to publish practical, people-first educational content about marketing, growth, AI tools and careers. Content should explain concepts clearly, use real examples where available and avoid keyword stuffing or unsupported guarantees.
